query: We are building a live market trading app. The order screen must use the current server quote and cannot safely accept offline orders. Should every new mobile app get a SQLite database and background sync by default?
expected_behavior: Does not prescribe a local database or sync engine for every mobile app
Checks offline requirements against the product contract before choosing storage or synchronization
Keeps current-quote and order submission requirements explicit and explains that stale or queued offline orders are unsafe for this product
Defines clear unavailable, pending, failed, and retry behavior while preserving any user-entered work where safe
